notes: Adds explicit Owner Department control for RA, COSHH RA, SSW, Policy, Procedure, Information and controlled Toolbox Talks. Owner Department controls review/follow-up responsibility and is automatically included in the relevant Training/read audience unless Everyone is selected; additional departments and people remain independently assignable. Admin can enable PPE and First Aid functions per Department. Department Manager/H&S Manager can assign the responsible person from current Department members. Department First Aid responsibility becomes the monthly default checker unless a First Aid box has its own override. Department PPE responsible people can see and action PPE issues for their Department. Existing document/version/training history is retained. Required Supabase migrations have already been applied to the live Safety Tracker project.
